KA KTIEN LAMPHRANG 

Ka jingthmu kaba kongsan ha kaba thoh ia kine ki jingthoh, 
ka long kurano ban kyntiew ia la ka ri bad ka jaitbynriew lyngba 
ka thoh ka pule. Naduh dang khynnah, la ju iohsngew ba kiba 
rangbah ki ialap-iariew shaphang ka jingkyrduh ki kot khasi. 
Kane ka jingpyrkhat ka la bat bad saiiidur ia ka jingmut naduh 
kata ka por. Ynda la kham san, ka la iiang jur ka jingangnud 
ban thoh kot bad la kut jingmut ba dei ban leh ei-ei da lade ne 
ban bah wait lyngngun da lade. 

Ka jingpyrshang ban lum jingtip lyngba ki jingthoh ka long 
1 a kam kaba jwat ; hynrei ka nang kham jwat shuh-shuh lada 
c’ei ban lum na ki briew kiba shu tipktien-tip pateng. Te khnang 
ban kham lashai lehse kan biang hi kat ban ring nuksa bad pyn- 
sriem malu-mala ba ka long kum u briew uba wad uba thud ban 
lap ia ka jaka badon ne shong mawpyrsut. Ynda u la lap, u hap 
pat ban tih ban shrot, ban khlong ban khlaw bad ban pyntuid-

pyakit ia u mawpyrsut sha ki wah. Ynda u la kie ha ki wah, 
donkam pat banjiarban snaid pateng-pateng, ban phleng ban 
pynkhuid haduh ba un da pliah bad bit ban leit lam sha ka shlem- 
sain-nar. Shuwa ban saifi pat, donkam biang ban da mang ban 
da thew ban da dong ban sain-pynum ha ka ding barhein ka pa- 
jvva haduh ba un da man narliang-narwah. Na une u nar-liang 
narwah pat, ki kamar bad ki nongshoh-thaw ki sa sain-pynwan- 
dur ha ka shloin jong ki ban shna ia ki wait ki tari, ki mohkhiew 
bad kiwei kiwei de ki tiar kiba donkam. Ym dei pat ruh ban 
klet ba ha kum kane ka jaid jingtrei, ka hoit ka jaw, ka tait ka 
bret, ka khoh ka phler, ka phret ka phrong kaba byllai. 

Don ki jingeh kiba mih na ka daw ba ki jingtip ki shong 
saphret saphnang ha kylleng ka ri, kumta ba hap ban khar ban 
tarn ban lum shitom shidkhoi nangne shidkhot pat nangtai. Don 
pat ba ki jirgtip ki shong thup shong thiar kum ki shyieng bun 
jait bun syrtap hapoh ka krem ka kroh, ka synrang ne ka thwei. 
Kumta ka la shim por slem-slem ban lah ban jied ban sot ban 
pyndait lang biang-pa-biang kat ban saindur ha kawei ka shruh 
ne ka shynrong (skeleton). 

Don ki jingtip kiba la shu ioh sriem kumba khalai-nusib ; 
ne long sriem kumba bthah ki tyramen, ba, ‘lada phi kwah ban 
ioh jingsiad, leit tong urn na wah ha ka por ne ka khyllipmat ba 
kawah ka iohthiah’. Don ki ricwtymmen kiba hadien slem-slem, 
ba la pyrsbang shitom, la lah shisha ban ioh iakynduh bad ia- 
shongkai bad ki. Hynrei kaba diaw ka long ba ka sien-shongkai 
kaba nyngkong (kaba teng-teng ka neh tang da ki minit) ka long 
artad ka sienshong-kai kaba khatduh. Haba jia kumne, poi haba 
jnang, namar shaei pat yn leit wad jingshai. Jar la katta ruh, ha 
ka jingbymbanse, la hap hi ban shu tare kulmar bad ban pyrshang 
ban batai tang katba lah ei ban shemphang. Kane ka pynkyn-

II 


maw ia uta u tymmen Sohra uba ong, “Ynda la poi ha u pud uba 
nga ia lade ruh ngam lah sngewthuh shuh, to ieh nga mat shu 
tharai, nangta ngan sa batai^ bad phi lah ban ong ia nga, u 
‘TharaUbataV ”, 

Kumba la kdew shakhmat, ki jingeh ha ka jinglum jingtip ki 
long kiba bun syrtap. Kawei na kita ka long ba don ki riew-tip- 
tymmen, hynrei ki lah pat ban batai tang ha ka ktien shnong. 
Nalor nangta, ki don ki ktien kiba ha ka ktien kot ki don kawei 
ka jingmut, katba ha ka ktien shnong pat ki kit da kawei ka jing- 
mut. 


Ka jingkylla ha ki juk bad ki por ruh ka wallam ia ka jing- 
kylla ha ki briew. Ha ki juk kiba ia leit noh, paidbah kiei-kiei 
ki long sngur long synlar. Ki briew ruh dang bun kiba kren 
kumba ki mut bad ki mut ruh kumba ki kren. Hynrei katba 
nangiaid ki por bad katba ki briew ki nang kam ialade kum kiba 
la kham long riewshai (civilised) katta la nang duna ka jinglong- 
sngur ka jinglong-nylla. Katba nangiaid ki por nang jur ki 
musli-musla, nangrben ka tahrong-tahrup, haduh u pud ba mar 
shisien jngoh ne shisien madj la shitom ban ithuh ne sngewthuh 
kano kaba nylla bad kano pat kaba tang na sla. 

Ka plie lad bad ka khanglad ki iaiaid synrap kumba thain 
pi-ar. Ha bym pat lait surok kali, bun kiei-kiei ki sah nylla ki 
sah synlar, hynrei ban leit Jngoh ia ki ka long kaba shitom. Hyn- 
rei ynda la lait kali pat, ka leit ka wan ka la suk shibun tangba 
bun kiei-kiei ki la kylla dur bak-ly-bak, bad slem ka ktien, don 
napdeng Jong ki kiba la i kumba kin duh jait noh syndon. Nang 
lait surok, nang synlen ki khlaw, nang iwa ki lum, nang rwa u 
shyiap, nang duna u maw, nang jngut ki wah, nang iwkhong ka

Iyer, nang rngad ki umtong-umdih. Don jaka-jaka kiba la Iwcl 
Iko hi pom sriem kumba hap bom ; don pat kiba la khynra pyn- 
kylla khongpong naduh tynrai sriem kumba khynniuh jumai. 
Teng-teng sngew kumba phohsniew ban iohi ba don ki khlaw kiba 
la ju iaid kjat da ki lai sngi saw sngi lynti pynban plain-ly-lain 
ki kylla lyndum tangbapoh khyndiat por khyndiat sngi. Ki dieng 
shi-piam-star ar-piam-star kiba la ieng rangbah jwaih kum ki 
syiem, ki lyngdoh ha ki lum bad ki them, la shu pam, shu ot, 
shu khet jubor khlem por khlem samoi. 

Ki skul ki la nang bun katba nang iaid ki sngi, bad don 
jaka-jaka ba ki la mih kumba jei ne ba ki la shu mih pathar kum 
ki tit. Ba ki jia ne ki wan ki jingkylla ym da don eh shibun ban 
da sngewphylla. Lajan baroh kiei-kiei ki kylla na ka por sha ka 
por, bad lehse kawei na ki bymjukylla ka long ka ain jong ki jing- 
kylla. Lada don ei-ei kaba kham phylla, kata ka long ka Jing- 
kylla stet jong kiei-kiei kaba ym ju ialap-iariew naduh ki juk kiba 
mynshuwa. Ki jingkylla kiba stet eh ki dei khamtam kito kiba la 
wan rah lyngba ka Science bad ka Technology.

KA JINGIM KA LONG KA JINGPYRSHANG 

Man la ka Aiom man la ka Por, ki don hi la ka khubor, ki 
don hi la ka antor. Ki juk ki wan bad ki juk ki leit. Ki pateng 
ki mih bad ki pateng ki jah. Ha la ka sap ka phong, ha la ba 
long ba long, ka bha hi katba lah, ban pyrshang shitom ban ia- 
iap-iariew pateng katba iohlad bad ban tip syn-ei. Ka bha ruh ban 
pyrshang ban lur ha la la i nur ryngkat ka jingkyrmen ba U Trai 
Nongthaw Un pynsei-soh sei-symbai, Un pynman thning pynman 
snap na ka bynta ki pateng ki ban dang wan ha ka lyngkha kaba

iar jong ka ri bad ka jait bynriew. 

Lajan kut (baroh) ki kam, ki dawa lakuinnokuranoia kawei 
na kine lada ym haroh, kata ia ka por, ka bor, bad ka pisa. 
Kumta ka long kaba eh, ia uba bun uba lang, ban leh bniah ha 
kano kano ka jingpyrshang kaba u trei raon sngewbha khlem bai- 
siew-baiseng ne khlem kano kano ka kynja scholarship. La 
sngewdei ban da ban khnang ia kane namar ha kane ka jjngpyr- 
shang, ki lah ban don ki bynta kiba ki Longdien ki lah ban pyr- 
khai ba la shu leh mata-madei ne leh tad-dep. Ka daw kaba 
kongsan eh, ka long namar ba la shu thohknieh-thohkynrup 
ryngkat ka syier ioh ba kumei-kumci, u Jingiap u lap ba kynthet 
noh ia ki Longshuwa ki Manshuwa, shuwa ba kin ang kin khlei 
pateng ia ka jingtip jong ki, ne ia u Nonglura-jingtip hi. 

Ha kane ka jait jingtrei, la pyrshang shitom ban lum ia ki 
laiphew har rukom ki plingit jingtip kiba iathain kyrwoh naduh u 
khla u thlen, uksuidukhrei, UTrai Nongbuh U Trai Nongthaw, 
ki blei ki dken, ka suifi ka Iyer, ka sngi u bnai, ki khlur, ka 
kpoh-ramew, ka kpoh-niamra bad katba lah ban tda shaduh lyn- 
det tyngkong ka sngi u bnai ne wat shaduh sha shakiar kajing- 
mutdur. 

La phriang hangne ia ki laiphewjait ki subject da ka jing- 
khmih lynti ba ki nongpule kin ioh lad ban iashim bynta Jang, 
ban iataw mar shi-kyntien ar-kyntien ne wat tang ban shu mad 
ne thoh tiak kumba thoh mluh. 

Ka jingtip, tang ka jingtip kam biang, la la lum ia ki jing- 
tip na kylleng ki trep bad ki skum. U nongthoh u kynmaw kyn- 
diang ba, ki tiar-shna-iing, la u sder ne phlang, u dieng u siej, 
ka lyntang ka thaboh, ka tin ka saraw, u maw-it u maw-blok, u 
mawria u shyiap ne ka dew-bilat bad kiwei kiwei kiba kum kita, 
kim dei satia ka iing^ kim dei satia ka jingtei. Kumjuh ruh ka doh 
ne ka dohkha, ka khi ka uinphniang, ujingshoh, ka mluh, ki

musli-musla bad kiwei kiwei de ki jnir shet^jyntah, kim dei satia 
ka jyntah, Ki ktien, ki sentens, ki dak sangeh, ki kyrteng briew 
bad kiwei-kiwei kim dei ka drama lane ka novel. Baroh kiei-kiei 



IV 


kl don la ki rukom la ka bait, ki don la ka ain la ka adong kiba 
donkam ban bud bniah bud ryntih ia ki^ khnang ban pynieng ia ka 
jingtei ne pynman ia ka jyntah, ne saindur ia ka drama. Kine pat 
ruh ki shong shikatdei ch ha ki kti uba lip uba nang ban shna 
ban saindur katba kum ka jingbit bad ka jingtbit jong u. 

Katba dangsah ha kane ka them ki um-mat, hateng-hateng 
ki wan shoh ki er-iong ka sukha ka dukha mynsiein bad ki er- 
lang-thari ka diaw bad ka blaw, hynrei ha uba Jah ban ap, iai- 
shah bad kyrmen, ki wan bch pat ruh ki er-batemon ka tngen bad 
ki er-batesi ka kmea. Kine ki pasiaw jein jai-jai ba, haba y.ii 
pat ioh paki-dulan, nang rich ha i trep i skum kyndob-madob, 
haba ym pat lait surok-kali, nang jam shitom thop-shi-thop ha ka 
lynti-khasi, namar kiei-kiei baroh ki don la ka dor, ha la ka hud, 
bad ka por. 

Ha ka por hyndai ka ju long ka rukom ba ki kynja riewtym- 
men bad ki riewtip-tymmen ki ju iathuhthaw-iathuhtang ha la ki 
khun ki ksiew ia ki jingtip kiba kordor ba ki la lum na la ki long- 
shuwa ki manshuwa. Ki khun ki ksiew ruh ki shah shkor kyn- 
diang, ki kynshcw ki kyndiap, ki ri ki sumar kyndong khnang ba 
kin lah ban ai pateng pat ha ki pateng kiba bud. Hynrei suki- 
suki katba ki briew ki nang tip kot-tipsla ki lakham iabeh satang 
ia ki jingthoh. Teng-teng ki da kynnoh ruh, ‘khlem jinglhoh, 
khlem dulir, te yn leit long shano ?’ Ka ktien-kren (spoken woid) 
ka la shong per bad ka la her noh. Sa tang ka ktien-thoh (written

word) kaba kham neh. 

Kawei na ki jingpyrshang jong u Nongthoh, ka long ba la 
ialeh shitom katba lah ban thoh tlem-thoh nylla ha katta ka ru- 
kom ba kiei-kiei kin paw haka dur kumba ki long. Kam pher la 
ki itynnat ibhabriew, jyllad-lymphuin kum u liew-myngngor kyl- 
lai-lyngsyun^ ne ki sniewbriew-sniewjcw sohkhroh-sohbroh kum 
ka hynroh. Na kaia ka daw la kiar katba Jah na ka thoh pynrem 
ne thoh pynksan, thoh-beift ne thoh-iaroh thoh-pynheh ne thoh- 
pynrit, thoh-khroh ne ihoh-bymsalia, ne kano-kano ka rukom 
thoh kaba lah ban mih na ka jingmut-jngut. Haduh katno kane 
ka jingpyrshang ka kynjoh sha katci ka jingthmu, ka shong ha ki 
nongpule ban bishar. 

Na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi jong ki paidbah nongpule kiba 
ym pat ju pule ia kine ki jait jingthoh mynshuwa, u nongthoh 
u la sngewdei ban shon hangne ia kine ki kyntieii kiba long kum ka 
nongrim bad ka jingpynshai ia kiba bun ki jingthoh kiba la kyn- 
thup hapoh kane ka kitab. 

^"Ka jingmut jong kiba bun kiei-kiei ka shong shibun eh ha ka 
rukom ba la pynkylla ne batai (interpret) ia ki^ katba kum kajing- 
iapher ki por bad ki jaka*\ 



V 


Ha kanc ka Ri Laiphew Syiem-Khatar-doloi, ka long kaei- 
kaei kaba eh katta-katta ban pyrshang ban ai kano-kano ka kyn- 
ja jingbatai kaba long salonsar kat ban biang ban khlup (cover) 
ia ka Ri baroh kawei. Ka daw ka long namar don bun kiei-kiei 
kiba iapher na kawei ka ilaka bad kawei pat, na kawei ka thain 
bad kawei pat, bad don ka jingiapher wat ha ka rukom-ring-sur

ne kynnoh ia ki ktien na shiliang-wah sha shiliang-wah ne na 
shiliang-lum sha shiliang-lum. Kumta bunsien lada don kiba 
ong — 

‘Sha ka thain jong ngi neshaka ilaka jong ngi, ki leh kumta- 
kumta; kiwei pat ki ong, sha ka thain jong ngi ne sha ka ilaka 
jong ngi pat kirn leh satia kunlta^ Ha kane ka rukom, kaei 
kaba la niew kum kaba bit kaba biang kaba iahap ia kawei ka 
thain, ka lah pat ban ym bit, ym biang, ym iahap ia kawei pat 
ka thain. 

La la pyrshang shitom ban kham bniah, pynban u nongthoh 
u sngewihuh ba ki jingbatai ki jngai ia ka jingjanai, hynrei u 
khmih lynti ba la kumno-kumno kin biang tang kum ka pruid- 
dak bad ka prat-Iynti. 

U Nongthoh u pynpaw ka jingsngewnguh ia baroh ki Long- 
shuwa ki Manshuwa (khlcm da hiewtang), kiba Jadaym dei daka 
jingiarap phylliew-jingtip jong ki, yn ym lah satia ban thoh ia 
kane ka kitab. U pynpaw ka jingsngewnguh kaba kyrpang ia u 
Rangbah B. L. Swer ba, nalor ka jingkyntu bad ka jingpynsblur 
ban pynmih ia kane ka kitab u la da ai syndon bad ki ktien kyn- 
pham halor kine ki jingpyrshang, 

Shuwa ban pynkut ii Nongthoh u pynpaw ruh ka jingsngew- 
nguh ia i Mr. Rockbornwel Soanes, Editor ka Kotkhubor 
‘Ka Rngi’ bad i Mr. J. Kharmih, Editor ‘Ka Pansara’ kiba la 
iarap lem ban pynphriang ia kine kijingthoh lyngba ka kotkhubor 
jong ki. la ki jingkynthoh kiba la ai, la shon lang ha kane ka 
kitab. 

Shuwa ban poi sha ba pynkut, u Nongthoh u pynpaw ka 
jingsngewnguh ia U Blei U Trai Nongthaw-Nongbuh, Uba, u 
ngeit, khlem ka jingiarap jong U, um lah ban leh ei-ei ruh em. 
U pynpaw ruh ka jingsngewnguh na ka bynta ka jingkyrshan bor

baroh kaba u ioh na la Rympei. 

Haba pyrkhat ia ka ngit-lngit bah kaba sah, bad ia ine i jing- 
pyrshang iba long tang kum i ‘phngit ne i thngit’ la sngewdei 
ban jer kyllum ia kine ki jingthoh ba ki long shisha tang ki 
‘katto-katne shaphang ki katto-katneV 



VI 


Shikyntien, kum ka ktien-ai-khublei, ym lah khlem da pyn- 
paw kyllum ia la ka jingsngewnguh kaba ym lah ong shuh ryngkat 
bad la ka jingsngewkit-ram ia baroh ki LoDgshuwa-Manshuwa na 
kiba la ioh lad ban kylli ban pyrthew, ban lum ban lang ia ki 
phngit'jingtip kiba la klum hapoh kane ka thup, bad ruh L ban 
sa paw pyrthei lyngba ki thup ki ban dang mih hadien. Don 
bun napdeng jong ki (ki Longshuwa-Manshuwa), kiba ym nang 
thoh nang pule, hynrei don pat ruh kiba la ioh shongskul. La 
pruid kyrkieh ia kine ki jingthoh tang kat ba kin ym jah noh, 
kyrmen ba yn sa nang kham pynbha irat na ka por sha ka por. 

La pyrshang ban thoh sriem kumba tyllun ka por ha ka 
shisngi — kata ban sdang naduh dang riew u syiar-nyngkong, 
suki-pa-suki baroh shisngi bad lyngba ka por sepsngi haduh ban 
da poi sha ka syn-nia, pynban hateng-hateng ka jingmut ne ka 
khmat ne ka dohnud briew, ki i kumba lada dum than ka pyn- 
ngiew bad lada shai than ruh ka pynsniew. Kaba biang hi ka 
del tang kaba shu pdcng bad kaba adkar. 

Kumba la thoh shakbmat, ka jingim ka dei ka Jingpyrshang. 
To ngin ia pyrshang ban nang laid shaphrang kaiba lah bor, katba 
shem lad bad katba shah por.

RNGI TREP,

VII 


LA MAIT lA KA PHANG THYMMAI

La slem ngi la iohi ia ka kyrtcng U Rangbah W. R. Laitflang 
(Uba ngi ju khot ieit khct jan — i Bah Wil) la ha ka makasin 
Ka Rngi ne ha Ka Pansara ha kaba la pynmih ia ki jingthoh ba la 
ai kyrteng “Katto katne shaphang ki katto katne”. Kum u 
briew uba ieit ia la ka ktien, ka kolshor bad litereshor jong ka, 
bad uba dang thrang bad kwah tip shuh shuh, ngani lah ban shu 
kbiini la ka shyntur khlcm iaroh ha kiwei bad ha une u nongthoh 
kumjuh. Ha la marwci nga la ju pyrkhat balei i Bah wil im pyn- 
mih pyrthci noh la kine ki jingthoh ha ka dur ka kot na ka bynta 
ka jingmyntoi kiwei bad lehse ban kham pynsuk ia ki research 
scholars. Ngi sngewbha shibun eh ba i Bah Wil myiita i la kloi 
ban shon la kane ka thup bad ban sam paidbah lem ia ki jingtip 
ba i la lum lyngba ka jingtrei shitom jong i lyngba ki laiphew 
sawphew sncm ei ei. 

Nga hi shimct ngam sngewnud ban kren kynthoh ei-ei halor 
kane ka Thup kaba kum ka par hah ia kito baroh kibaieit ia Jaka 
ktien ka thylliej ba kan roi kan par kau san kan heh na ka por 
sha ka por. Nga ong ‘par bah’ namar hangne ngin shem lehse 
ja kiba ngi la tip niuina hynrei pat shi smam ryngkap ia kiba 
bun ki bym pal shym la latip. Ha nga hi nga shem ba don bun 
ki kynticn ba ngi ju lakren lapyndonkam man ka sngi hynrei haba 
shah kylli pyrthew ngi dum buit jlang ban batai namar ngim tip 
ki wan na ei ne mih na ei ha ka jinglong tynrai jong ki. I Bah 
Wil, kum u briew uba ieit bad niewkor ia la ka ktien, i la pyr- 
shang ban jubab ei ei katba don la i bor halor ka jingpyrta u 
Myllung Soso Tham mynnor. 

“Jingshai ngi wad sawdong pyrthei, 

Jingshai Ka Ri ngim tip ei ei”. 

Don bun jait ki jingieit-ri kiba uno uno ne kano kano ki lah 
ban pynpaw. Kawei na kita kaba nga ngeit ka long halor kane 
ka jingong ba ka “Jaitbynriew ka ira haba ka ktien ka im"’, kaba

long ka jingsawa kyrtoh ha ki tyndong shkor jong nga la slcm 
mynta. Ngam artatien ba kane ka jingsngew ka long kumjuh 
bad i Bah Wil. 

Haba phai biang sha kane ka Thup kaba yin pat ju don koit 
ha ka thoh ka tar Khasi, nga tip shai ka long kaba nyngkong 
duh ka ban noh synniang sha kata ka jylli pule kaba ki khot Ka 
linguistics^ khamtamhaki tnat-pule jong ka kaba ki khot ka 
morphology bad etymology nalor kiwei kiwei pat ki shat-jingtip

KI NONG-IAM-WAI : Kane ka jingong ka kham thew ia kito 
ki nong-iam-briew kiba wai da ka nong ne siew da ka bainong 
khnang ban iam briew ha ka por ba iap briew. Ka ju long paid-

ki sngi ki ia, ki taiew ki bnai ne da ki snem. Kham bunsien, kane 
ka jingtyngkai metiap ka iasnoh bad ka jingleh-niam-leh-rukom, 
jingleh-nam-leh-burom, kat kum ka rta, kyrdan longbricw, jing- 
don jingem, jingbun u kur u kha bad kiwei kiwei de ki daw. 
Lada ym don kaei-kaei ka daw kaba khanglad, kham bunsien 
kim ju tep ne thang ha kajuh hi ka sngi ba u briew u iap. 

Haba don kiba sngewkwah ban da Ich nam Ich burom ia u, 
ki ju da wai kyrpang da ki nongiam-briew (namar kam ju don ka 
ruicom ban da kren da khana shaphang uba iap). Katba lah ban 
tip ban iohi paidbah, ki nongiam-wai ki dei ki kynthei. Kine ki 
nnngiam-wai ki long kiba la mlien bad tbit ha la ka jong ka kam. 
Kim shu iam bicit ne iam bthcr ne iam katba kynduh, hynrei 
ki da oh ki da phawar ha kata ka sur phawar ka baih-bamyllung

bad ki da hiewtang ruh bin-pa-bin haduh ba kiba sngap ki da 
sngew ia kinc ki iiongiam ba ki Jong syriem ia u poet ne philoso- 
pher. Haba iap u kynja riewrangbaJi, ki iam ki ong bad pyn- 
syriem ba uta uta u la long syriem kum u dieng-bah uba la shan 
la shar ia ka sngi ka Iyer bad uba hapoh kasyrngiew jong u, la ju 
rich tngen u shnong u thaw, ka kynthei ka khynnah u duk u suk, 
ka rangli ka juki, u kup shiliarg, u sem shiliarg ; hynrei mynta 
ba u dieng-bah ula khyllcm, ka shnong ka thaw ka la shongsyier 
shong smiej, ka kur ka jait, ka iing ka sem baroh ki la blaw bad 
la long sah khynnah bad ka iaid ka ieng kam sngewshngain shuh. 
Don pat ki nongiam kiba fiicw-tang da kaba oh, banaduh ba phi 
la-wan-poi-kha, naduh ba phi la shongkha ma phi, ym ju don ka 
sang, ym ju don ka ma, ym ju don ka iaid lyndet ka leh lyndet,

ka kamai ka kajih, ka lynti ka dwar ki roi ki pa bad ki iaid beit 
iaid ryntih, ym ju don ka thok ka shukor, ka raibi ka sangbi ne 
ka tyrut ka smer baroh ki iaid beit da kaba suk kaba bha suda :

wat buhnud, wat leit buh-khoh buh-jaw. Kumba phi la iohi hi

ryngkat ki lok ki jor, to da kyrkhu ma phi la ki kur ki kha, na
